root.claim: On one deterministic machine with a fixed finite alphabet and a fixed number of one-dimensional tapes, two $n$-bit integers multiply exactly in worst-case time $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, with $\kappa=2^{-182}$.
root.method: show that the fixed-tape tools are cheap and accurate, show that the transform pipeline returns the exact product, then bound its total cost

motivation.text: The claim has three parts, all about one algorithm: its tape operations, its exactness and its total cost.
